about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Fourth Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May Thy gifts, O God, free us from earthly delights and ever renew us with heavenly nourishment. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
